items.title: Rhode Island School Counselor Association — Education By Entertainment 2026 Program
items.summary: We had a great time showing school counselors and educators more about how they think—while having a TON of FUN!This program was delivered for the Rhode Island School Counselor Association (RISCA) on November 2, 2026. We used interactive "Mind Games" to explore multitasking, attention to detail, and perception.Participants described these activities as:FUNInteractiveEntertainingEngagingEnlighteningHighlights of the program included the "Blindfolded Beanie Baby Walk," "What's On My Hands," and the "Champion’s Final Exam," which reminds us of an important message for all educators: Don’t Forget Yourself!!!Education By Entertainment programs are designed to show people more about how they think through interactive "discovery" activities. They are perfect for businesses, conferences, conventions, schools, and social events. Our programs are appropriate for everyone from professionals to third graders.We put the FUN into FUNdraisers!!!We LOVE birthdays!Keywords: Rhode Island School Counselor Association, RISCA, School Counseling, Educator Professional Development, Student Engagement, Cognitive Psychology, School Assemblies, Interactive Learning, Career Development, Dr. Ronald G. Shapiro.
